title: GitHub Portfolio Search
one_liner: Semantic search engine for personal GitHub repositories using embeddings and TF-IDF.
what_it_is: A tool that indexes GitHub repositories, extracts README content, generates embeddings, and provides a searchable interface via CLI, web UI, and MCP server to find reusable code patterns across a user's portfolio.
how_its_built: Python backend with FastAPI for serving data, SQLite-vec for vector storage, sentence-transformers for embeddings, and a static HTML/JS frontend. Indexing is handled by a Python pipeline triggered locally or via GitHub Actions.
how_to_apply: Clone the repo, configure a GitHub token, index your repositories using the CLI, and serve the web UI or integrate the MCP server into AI agents like Claude Code for context-aware code discovery.
quickstart:
git clone https://github.com/davidbmar/github-portfolio-search.git
cd github-portfolio-search
python3 -m venv .venv
source .venv/bin/activate
pip install -e ".[dev]"
cp .env.example .env
ghps index <your_github_username>
ghps export
cd web && python3 -m http.server 8000
features: Client-side semantic search using TF-IDF and embedding vectors
Automated capability clustering of repositories into categories
MCP server integration for AI agent access to portfolio data
Faceted filtering by language, tech stack, and star count
Auto-generated documentation and README snippets for search results
Weekly automated reindexing via GitHub Actions
